claude.sample_unit: online web texts on generalized pustular psoriasis

links.outcome: Reliability and quality (DISCERN) of LLM-simplified patient education text versus original
links.effect: LLMs improved readability but scored lower on DISCERN than the original text (p<0.01), so simplified content did not preserve reliability and quality.
links.quote: While LLMs improved readability, they did not preserve the original content's reliability and quality.

links.outcome: Reading level of online health information on GPP relative to recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Online dermatology health information often exceeds the recommended sixth-grade reading level; LLMs reworded texts to a sixth-grade level and significantly improved readability (p<0.01).
links.quote: Online health information (OHI) in dermatology often exceeds the recommended sixth-grade reading level, hindering patient comprehension.

links.effect: All LLMs significantly improved readability/reduced reading level (p<0.01) but had lower DISCERN scores than original text (p<0.01).
links.quote: All LLMs significantly reduced readability (p<0.01) but scored lower on the DISCERN instrument compared to the original text (p<0.01).

links.effect: LLMs improved readability, but did not preserve original reliability and quality.
links.quote: While LLMs improved readability, they did not preserve the original content's reliability and quality.

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-reworded patient education texts
links.effect: All LLMs significantly reduced readability scores to improve readability (p<0.01) but scored lower on DISCERN (p<0.01).
links.quote: All LLMs significantly reduced readability (p<0.01) but scored lower on the DISCERN instrument compared to the original text (p<0.01).

unlisted_practices: Using large language models to reword online patient education materials to a sixth-grade reading level
